standard: Visible refinement acceptable at application scale; not a numerical quality score or release approval.

front.note: Three rows of separate hex dumbbells remain supported by the compact angled rack.

rear.note: The reverse view retains the paired rails and broad stabilizing feet.

detail.note: The individual metal grips, hex weight ends and softly edged rack joints stay legible.

underside.note: The lower view shows the loaded rails connected to both angled frame sides.

clay.note: The weight rows and supporting frame remain distinct without material color.

front.note: The border is dense, but its flower clusters and leaf edges still read as angular cutouts.

rear.note: The opposite view preserves many separate stalks, yet repeats the pointed polygon leaf silhouettes.

detail.note: Full detail shows four-petal florets as flat angular tiles and broad jagged leaf surfaces; rounded cupped petals and more coherent leaf outlines are needed.

underside.note: The original stalk connections remain complete beneath the clusters and should be preserved.

clay.note: Clay confirms that the angular petals and leaves are geometry limitations rather than only material color.

front.note: The saddle, flywheel and separate handlebar support retain a clear exercise-bike silhouette.

rear.note: The opposite view keeps the crank, pedals and frame junctions connected.

detail.note: The small display, resistance knob and layered flywheel rim remain distinct with restrained metal highlights.

underside.note: Both stabilizer bars and the frame remain connected beneath the pedals.

clay.note: The flywheel, seat and handlebar arrangement remains recognizable in clay.

front.note: The carpeted slope meets a small upper landing within separate timber edge rails.

rear.note: The rear view retains the elevated landing legs and diagonal support arrangement.

detail.note: The carpet strip, timber side rails and small rubber foot caps remain distinct.

underside.note: The closed ramp deck and landing supports remain complete below.

clay.note: The inclined path and supported landing stay clear in clay; the source's slender timber construction is retained.

front.note: The portable slab retains three clean heating-zone rings and its small front control marks.

rear.note: The opposite view preserves the complete softly edged housing.

detail.note: The original concentric markings and discrete controls remain legible on the restrained dark top.

underside.note: The underside stays closed with no accidental opening or detached trim.

clay.note: The compact slab silhouette remains coherent without color; heating symbols are retained decorative markings.

front.note: The paired shutters retain separate tilted slats within the timber perimeter frame.

rear.note: The reverse view clearly shows the louver depth and divided upper and lower sections.

detail.note: Slat spacing, small central knobs and vertical adjustment rods remain legible.

underside.note: The lower angle keeps the tilted louvers enclosed by the original rails.

clay.note: The repeated open louver structure remains clear in clay.

front.note: The circular rug remains a series of smooth concentric ridges rather than convincing woven jute.

rear.note: The opposite view repeats the same uniform ring pattern without a textile construction cue.

detail.note: Full detail shows smooth plastic-like bands and regular grooves; bounded strand or braid relief is needed while retaining the circular pattern.

underside.note: The backing is closed and thin and should remain intact during the surface construction correction.

clay.note: The concentric rigid rings remain evident in clay, so a material-only change is insufficient.

front.note: The kettle grill is recognizable, but its broad lid and lower bowl remain visibly faceted.

rear.note: The opposite view repeats the stepped dome contour above the preserved legs and wheels.

detail.note: Full detail exposes large flat latitude bands and polygonal radial panels across the lid.

underside.note: The legs, ash catcher and underside remain complete; repair should smooth the authored closed bowl and lid profiles.

clay.note: The coarse dome silhouette remains conspicuous in clay despite the improved surface response.

front.note: The key field is recognizable, but every key has the same size and the mouse is a plain rectangular block.

rear.note: The reverse view confirms the mouse has no button separation or scroll control.

detail.note: Full detail shows a uniform tile grid without a spacebar or differentiated bottom-row construction.

underside.note: The keyboard and mouse bases remain closed and correctly separated; their original footprints should be retained.

clay.note: The featureless mouse block and undifferentiated key layout remain obvious without materials.

front.note: Three forward-facing book rows remain contained behind separate display rails.

rear.note: The closed rear panel and tall side cheeks retain the original display case construction.

detail.note: Individual book covers and simple title panels remain legible above the front retainers.

underside.note: The closed base and stepped retaining rails remain connected underneath.

clay.note: The three display levels and individual book shapes stay readable in clay.

front.note: The framed drawing board sits on an open A-frame with its original small tray.

rear.note: The reverse face and rear legs remain complete and aligned.

detail.note: The original house drawing, separate chalk marks and tray edges stay legible.

underside.note: The lower view confirms the board frame, tray supports and four legs remain connected.

clay.note: The hinged-looking A-frame and separate drawing panel remain clear in clay.

front.note: The house frame and bedding remain recognizable, but the pillow has a visibly floating rear seam.

rear.note: The opposite view retains the complete frame and closed mattress platform.

detail.note: Full detail confirms the thin pillow welt rises above and behind the pillow instead of following its cover.

underside.note: The platform and lower timber rails remain complete and should be preserved.

clay.note: The disconnected pillow edging remains visible in clay; this requires an exact seam-contact correction.

front.note: The round tabletop and pedestal remain visibly polygonal at their broad edges.

rear.note: The same coarse circular contour is evident around the opposite top and foot.

detail.note: Full detail shows straight radial segments around the slab and lower base despite smooth shading.

underside.note: The top and foot are closed and supported; the correction should preserve their measured turned profiles.

clay.note: The faceted circular silhouette remains clear without materials.

front.note: The seat remains supported, but its edge piping appears as broken exposed fragments.

rear.note: The wraparound shell retains its source construction yet has a coarse outer contour.

detail.note: Full detail shows the purple seat welt alternately buried and floating around the lofted cover; the shell edging is also angular.

underside.note: The four legs and structural seat pan remain complete and should not change.

clay.note: The coarse shell outline and disconnected piping remain visible in clay and need source-specific refinement.

front.note: The thin rug retains its distinct alternating diamond pattern and fine edge fringe.

rear.note: The opposite view preserves the same orderly color-block arrangement.

detail.note: The original diamond boundaries and small individual fringe strands stay legible with restrained textile relief.

underside.note: The backing is closed and the fringe continues at both short ends.

clay.note: Clay retains a thin cloth-like slab and fine fringe; the woven pattern itself remains defined by its original material divisions.

front.note: The bowl has a smooth rounded wall and a clearly recessed interior.

rear.note: The opposite side preserves the same even rim and tapered lower profile.

detail.note: The fine lip, open cavity and restrained glaze highlights remain readable at close range.

underside.note: The closed base and small foot ring remain complete underneath.

clay.note: The smooth hollow bowl construction stays clear in clay.

front.note: The separate lid, recessed handle and small lower control panel retain clear chest-freezer construction.

rear.note: The rear hinges and lower ventilation panel remain attached.

detail.note: The lid seam and softly edged body remain distinct without losing the original control detail.

underside.note: The closed dark base and original feet remain complete below.

clay.note: The separate top-opening lid remains readable in clay; no opening animation is inferred.

front.note: The two cabinet doors retain clean gaps below the separate white worktop.

rear.note: The closed rear and side panels remain aligned with the top overhang.

detail.note: Long recessed-looking pulls and eased slab edges remain distinct.

underside.note: The closed bottom and recessed dark plinth remain complete beneath the doors.

clay.note: The worktop, paired doors and plinth retain a clear hierarchy without color.

front.note: The glazed front, upper control band and compact case remain a clear countertop appliance.

rear.note: The rear ventilation grille and two service connections remain present.

detail.note: The original display, small buttons and visible interior rack retain legible detail.

underside.note: The base remains closed beneath the framed door and its handle.

clay.note: The framed front panel and compact case remain distinct in clay.

front.note: The board retains alternating lamella strips within a softly edged rectangular slab.

rear.note: The opposite view preserves its shallow side grip and complete perimeter.

detail.note: The original strip joints and eased outer edges remain legible; the wood finish remains deliberately restrained.

underside.note: The underside is closed with the lamella pattern continuing across the slab.

clay.note: The thin laminated-board construction remains readable without the wood colors.

front.note: The plate retains a smooth raised rim around a shallow recessed eating surface.

rear.note: The opposite view keeps an even circular outline and gentle dish profile.

detail.note: The fine rounded lip and restrained glaze highlights remain clean at close range.

underside.note: The closed underside and low foot ring remain intact.

clay.note: The shallow recessed plate form remains clear in clay.

front.note: The mug body is smooth and hollow, but the handle has a coarse angular loop.

rear.note: The opposite view repeats the visibly segmented handle silhouette.

detail.note: Full detail shows abrupt polygonal handle bends and blocky attachment transitions beside the smooth ceramic wall.

underside.note: The mug bottom and foot ring are closed; its genuine interior cavity should remain untouched.

clay.note: The angular handle remains conspicuous in clay and needs a smooth source-bounded loop.

front.note: The pan retains a real shallow cavity and a separate long handle.

rear.note: The opposite view preserves the round rim and the small hanging opening at the handle end.

detail.note: The rolled lip and paired metal handle attachments remain distinct under restrained textured metal response.

underside.note: The closed heat-spreader base and attached handle remain complete underneath.

clay.note: The recessed pan bowl and straight handle remain recognizable without material highlights.

front.note: The upright board retains its shaped shoulders and projecting handle.

rear.note: The reverse view preserves the same complete thin-board silhouette.

detail.note: The hanging hole and subtle lamella seams remain distinct with eased edges.

underside.note: The lower angle confirms a real through-hole and a closed board edge.

clay.note: The handled-board outline remains clear in clay; the simple wood surface is retained.

front.note: The three cabinet fronts remain evenly divided below the separate broad worktop.

rear.note: The closed back panel and modest worktop overhang retain the original island footprint.

detail.note: Individual door gaps and long dark pulls remain distinct with softened case edges.

underside.note: The recessed dark plinth and closed bottom remain complete.

clay.note: The three-door base and overhanging slab remain readable in clay.

front.note: The suspended extractor retains a separate chimney and layered lower canopy.

rear.note: The opposite side preserves the complete chimney seam and canopy perimeter.

detail.note: The telescopic chimney division and fine canopy rails remain clearly modeled.

underside.note: The underside shows three separate filter grilles, control marks and two small lights.

clay.note: The layered extractor construction remains legible without metal reflections.

front.note: Five individual glazed shades remain suspended at even intervals below the brass bar.

rear.note: The reverse view retains the five cords and separate socket fittings.

detail.note: Original ribbed glass, visible bulbs and fine brass rims remain clear.

underside.note: Each lower shade opening and bulb stays visible beneath the suspension bar.

clay.note: The five distinct pendants and their common support remain readable in clay.

front.note: The independent appliance retains a framed dark window, control band and horizontal pull.

rear.note: The rear case and upper ventilation slots remain complete.

detail.note: The original display, square buttons and fitted handle stay legible.

underside.note: The closed bottom and door frame remain attached underneath.

clay.note: The distinct control band and drawer-like front remain clear in clay.

front.note: The open appliance bay remains separate above the lower storage drawer.

rear.note: The original partially open rear allows the intended appliance installation space.

detail.note: The bay floor, side panels and small brass drawer pull remain clearly fitted.

underside.note: The closed base and four small feet remain connected below the open-bay cabinet.

clay.note: The empty appliance recess and lower drawer remain readable without color.

front.note: The shallow copper shade, brass socket and thin suspension cord retain a coherent pendant silhouette.

rear.note: The opposite view keeps the same smooth spun-shade contour.

detail.note: The socket-to-cord connection and fine rolled rim remain legible with subdued surface response.

underside.note: The sealed lower disc is the source's explicitly named recessed warm diffuser, so it is retained rather than treated as a missing opening.

clay.note: The shallow shade and complete suspension remain clear in clay.

front.note: The separate fluted glass shade, visible bulb and brass rim retain clear pendant construction.

rear.note: The opposite view preserves the fine glass ribs and central suspension.

detail.note: The small socket and ribbed glass remain distinct without changing the original optical material.

underside.note: The lower opening, rim and bulb remain visible from underneath.

clay.note: The fluted shade outline and separate top fitting remain legible in clay.

front.note: The two articulated-looking brass arms retain separate pivots and end valves.

rear.note: The reverse view keeps the wall escutcheon and projecting arm arrangement complete.

detail.note: Pivot sleeves, lever handles and fine collar rings remain clearly modeled.

underside.note: The lower view retains the small outlet fitting and connected wall-side joint.

clay.note: The jointed two-arm silhouette remains readable without reflections; no plumbing performance is implied.

front.note: The tall saucepan has a real open cavity and a separate long handle.

rear.note: The opposite view preserves the circular rim and small handle-end opening.

detail.note: The thin rolled lip and metal handle brackets remain legible under the restrained surface grain.

underside.note: The closed heat-spreader base remains aligned with the pan wall.

clay.note: The deep cylindrical vessel and attached handle remain clear in clay.

front.note: The pot retains a separate fitted lid and two opposed side handles.

rear.note: The reverse view keeps both handle attachments and the closed lid complete.

detail.note: The lid knob, tiny vent and rolled pot rim remain distinct at close range.

underside.note: The closed heat-spreader base and both handle roots remain connected underneath.

clay.note: The lidded vessel and paired side handles remain readable without metal highlights.

front.note: The tall single door retains its small display, pull and distinct perimeter seam.

rear.note: The closed rear and original corner details remain complete.

detail.note: The display, lock detail and softly edged handle remain legible on the simple door.

underside.note: The base and small feet remain closed and aligned beneath the case.

clay.note: The tall appliance silhouette and separate door remain clear in clay.

front.note: The wall rail retains separate ladle, slotted turner, whisk and small hanging cup.

rear.note: The reverse view preserves each utensil outline and the original rail supports.

detail.note: The hooked attachments, turner slots and open wire whisk remain individually legible.

underside.note: The cup bottom and concave ladle remain complete beneath the suspended tools.

clay.note: The varied utensil silhouettes and common rail remain recognizable without material colors.
